newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello to decide on rest of cuts next yr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello to decide on rest of cuts next yr.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said the size and direction of any further fiscal measures beyond the A$7.2 billion announced for next fiscal year, would be decided next year.

Asked whether the rest of the promised A$8 billion fiscal tightening would be announced in the May budget, Costello said: "We will assess over the year before our next budget whether we need fine-tuning and the direction in which that should go, so we will leave those sorts of decisions to next year's budget."
The government announced fiscal measure in last Tuesday's budget that cut A$3.9 billion from the deficit in the year to June 1997 and A$7.2 billion in 1996/97.
It had promised to implement A$8 billion in measures by 1997/98.

With those measures, the government now estimates a A$5.6 billion deficit in 1996/97, a A$1.5 billion deficit in 1997/98 and a A$1.0 billion surplus in 1998/99 -- all of those balances in underlying terms, which excludes asset sales.
